title: Optimize Medal
name: optimize-medal
modal: Medal will be closed to apply this. Lower clip resolution and bitrate in Medal settings if clips still lag.
description: Clears Medal cache and whitelists it in Defender so background recording stops eating FPS
deepDescription:
This changes Medal for better in-game performance:

- Cache, Code Cache, GPUCache → Cleared
- Defender exclusion for the Medal folder → On (stops real-time scanning of the recorder)

Do manually in Medal for full effect: use GPU encoder, lower clip bitrate, disable Auto Clipping.
